claude_proposed_widenings.name: difficult_terrain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Grease creates Difficult Terrain in a 10-foot square for 1 minute. Difficult terrain halves movement speed — mechanically distinct from block_travel (which prevents movement entirely). No v4 atom covers terrain-speed modification.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Nonflammable grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into Difficult Terrain for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Grease applies a repeated DEX save gate to every creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. OngoingOperation currently only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. A save_gate variant is needed with: ability, dc, onFail (apply_condition prone), onSuccess (none), and a trigger set (enters_area | ends_turn_in_area).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AnchoredEvent.ends_turn_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Grease fires the save gate when a creature ends its turn in the area — a distinct trigger from enters_area. The existing AnchoredEvent union has physical_contact and enters_area but not ends_turn_in_area. (This would also be needed as a trigger kind on the proposed OngoingOperation.save_gate.)
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.
